text: 7月14日，中国汽车工业协会后市场分会发布澄清声明，称《2025中国汽车后市场年度发展报告》传统动力类型乘用车在用车平均车龄约8.2年，新能源乘用车普及时间短、近年销量高速增长、新增上牌车辆占比高，因此，整体存量新能源乘用车平均车龄约1.8年。该数值仅反映的是行业转型发展现阶段特征，与当前市场情况一致，符合客观事实和现实体感，不代表车主仅1.8年就更换车辆，也不代表车辆使用寿命平均为1.8年。
text_en: On July 14, the Aftermarket Branch of the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers issued a clarification statement, stating that the '2025 China Automotive Aftermarket Annual Development Report' indicates the average age of traditional fuel passenger cars in use is approximately 8.2 years. New energy passenger cars have a short penetration time, high sales growth in recent years, and a high proportion of newly registered vehicles. Therefore, the overall stock of new energy passenger cars has an average age of approximately 1.8 years. This figure only reflects the current characteristics of the industry's transformation and development stage, consistent with the current market situation and objective facts and actual experience. It does not mean that owners replace vehicles after only 1.8 years, nor does it represent an average vehicle service life of 1.8 years.
